prediction_text: Winner: Barack Obama (re-elected). Prediction: incumbent President Obama defeats Mitt Romney in the 6 November 2012 election and wins a second term; the race stays competitive in polling but the electoral outcome is not an upset. Mercury turning retrograde on election day produces counting/administrative noise and disputes around the margins, not a reversal of the result.
basis:
WP-003 card marker: 2012 US presidential election, asked May 2012, incumbent Obama vs presumptive nominee Romney, election 6 November 2012 the day Mercury retrograde begins. No tradition field is annotated on the card; decided from the card's genre (mundane/election astrology) itself.
Basis: incumbency in mundane election reading is the default unless the chart shows a strong displacement signature; the card supplies none comparable to 2008's exact Saturn-Uranus opposition — Mercury retrograde at the vote speaks to procedure and recount-style friction, not to who wins. Direction therefore follows the incumbent, with the retrograde assigned to process noise only.
